blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Animal Welfare Society (PAWS) has urged owners of 29 pets dumped in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan, to pursue legal action against the pet crematorium, saying the incident may constitute estafa by means of deceit. In a statement on Saturday, PAWS said affected pet parents were led to believe that Ahjay Paws Aftercare Pet Crematorium, based in Bacoor City, Cavite, had cremated the departed pets entrusted to its care. However, “this was false and induced pet parents to pay for the service.” READ: All dead pets dumped in Bulacan claimed by owners – rescue group According […]...
